notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and causing target opponent to create a 11 Hippo creature token.
The Hippo enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Suture Priest's second ability.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing the Hippo token's controller to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
